findings.issue: Task 3 Details states 'StepExecutor.java — новий case у execute switch; Outcome.COMPLETE + StepResult.complete(); виклик уже-інжектованого funnelEventService'. The Outcome enum is in StepExecutor (line 329: 'public enum Outcome { CONTINUE, DELAY, CANCEL, FAIL, WAIT_FOR_REPLY }'). Task correctly identifies it needs to be extended. The StepResult record with its static factories (cont, delay, cancel, fail, waitForReply) is at line 338 onward. Adding COMPLETE to Outcome and complete() factory to StepResult is feasible — it's an additive change to an inner enum and record.

Task 3 says 'Outcome.COMPLETE + StepResult.complete()' in step 4 as part of StepExecutor, but the FunnelExecutionEngine.drive switch is exhaustive (all 5 Outcome values covered: CONTINUE, DELAY, WAIT_FOR_REPLY, CANCEL, FAIL). Adding COMPLETE to the Outcome enum will make the drive switch non-exhaustive but it is NOT a Java switch expression — it is a switch statement with explicit cases (no default). Java switch statements do NOT require exhaustiveness, so this WON'T cause a compile error. However task text says 'exhaustive switch'і компілюються з новим типом' in AC — this is only true for switch expressions (like in StepExecutor.execute which uses 'return switch'), not for the switch statement in FunnelExecutionEngine.drive. The task must add the case COMPLETE to drive manually — the compile won't force it. This is feasible but developers must be careful not to rely on compile-time enforcement for the drive switch.
findings.fix: Clarify in AC: the drive switch in FunnelExecutionEngine is a statement (not expression), so it will NOT fail to compile when COMPLETE is added to Outcome without a case. The task must explicitly add the case COMPLETE branch in drive — this is already described in step 5, but the AC claim about 'exhaustive switch'і компілюються' is only applicable to switch expressions, not the drive switch statement.

findings.issue: Task 2 test file target is FunnelServiceEmitEventTest. The actual class is focused on EMIT_EVENT validation (eventName slug, round-trip). Adding SUBSCRIBE_TO_FUNNEL validation tests there is consistent — the class already extends AbstractIntegrationTest and covers FunnelService validation paths. The helper 'emitStep(String eventName)' creates a FunnelStepDto with 17 constructor args (the current record has 17 fields). Adding 3 new fields (targetFunnelId, targetEntryStepId, endParentAfter) in Task 1 will make the record have 20 fields. The existing emitStep() helper in the test will break (wrong arity). Task 2 acknowledges this: 'Helper subscribeStep(...) — конструктор виріс на 3 поля в Task 1; узгодити порядок аргументів з фактичним record після Task 1.' However the task does NOT mention updating the existing emitStep() helper. After Task 1, the existing test helper becomes invalid and the existing passing test emitEvent_requiresValidEventNameSlug will break until the helper is updated.
findings.fix: Task 2 should explicitly note that after Task 1 expands FunnelStepDto to 20 fields, the existing emitStep() helper in FunnelServiceEmitEventTest also needs to be updated to pass null for the 3 new fields, in addition to creating the new subscribeStep() helper.
